svg.title: NH38A Appearance 1 with Royal Ulster Constabulary emblem
svg.desc: The crowned harp badge of the Royal Ulster Constabulary is centered above Appearance 1. The manufacturer movement drawings and labels below are unchanged. The badge was added for this journal and is not part of TMI's original specification sheet.
svg.metadata: Drawing: TMI NH38A specification, PDF page 3, https://www.timemodule.com/upload/category/27/spec_sheet/NH38_SS.pdf ; colors adapted to warm ivory and charcoal. Separate badge artwork: MrPenguin20, with elements by Sodacan and Tonyjeff, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Badge_of_the_Royal_Ulster_Constabulary.svg, CC BY-SA 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Badge adaptation: saturation reduced to 0.45; the badge adaptation remains CC BY-SA 3.0. The license does not cover the separate TMI drawing.
